spanish: Y dijo Moisés a ellos: Si pasaren hijos de Gad e hijos de Rubén con ustedes el Jordán, todo extracto a la guerra delante de Jehová, y sea sojuzgada la tierra delante de ustedes, y darán a ellos tierra del Galaad a posesión.

findings.issue: כָּל + qal passive participle ms חָלוּץ + לַמִּלְחָמָה licenses every one drawn out/equipped for the war. «extracto» is a different noun (an extract/excerpt) and drops the passive participle.
3mp qal imperfect is kept, but «pasaren» is obsolete future subjunctive rather than current Latin American (pasan/pasaran).
Niphal sequential perfect 3fs is a real result in the condition; «sea» is subjunctive and can be read as a jussive. Passive and feminine singular are kept.

notes: 2mp וּנְתַתֶּם as «darán» is ustedes future, not a third-party shift.
